successors.name: Kingdom of Wessex
successors.text: 'After this point, the island became a part of Wessex and later England'

ledger.x: 534: Wihtgar and Stuf receive the Isle of Wight from Cynric.
661: Wulfhere of Mercia conquers the Isle of Wight and gives it to Sussex.
686: Cædwalla of Wessex invades the Isle of Wight.

wars.name: Mercian conquest of the Isle of Wight
wars.outcome: Wulfhere conquered the island and gave the overlordship to Æthelwealh of Sussex.

wars.name: Cædwalla's conquest of the Isle of Wight
wars.outcome: Arwald, the last heathen Anglo-Saxon king, died resisting; his brothers were executed; the island became part of Wessex.

certainty.note: The island's shore is a natural limit; no page opened gives a treaty or survey line, and the kingdom's existence in the early centuries is partly legendary.
